reason: Research was thin, so this HOLD rests mostly on the packet. Two WebSearch queries on MSFT and UNH returned mostly dated items; the most current MSFT item said fiscal Q1 2027 earnings are due 2026-10-27, which is a catalyst the book would hold through. The MSFT leg (14%, +33.65%) carries no stop, but it is the book's largest winner and churning it into an earnings event would add frictions for no evidenced edge. The UNH leg (8%, -9.86%) has analyst support in the search results (Evercore Outperform $400, RBC $408, Bernstein $444 targets; dated, so not current) and a prior-authorization rollback in October that could pressure margins; with no confirmed news for the week of 2026-10-09, I am not cutting it on this evidence. No WebFetch was used. Week-of-10-09 news for the book's other names was not found, so this is an admitted limitation, not a considered view on each leg.
